resolution.reason: Not catalog content: 'keeloq_mfcodes' is the Flipper Zero Sub-GHz manufacturer-code asset file (proprietary KeeLoq rolling-code keys), not an ESP32 board or firmware; the GSC rows (10-14 impressions/day, position ~9-10, 2026-11-03..08) land on firmware/flipper-zero-esp32-adv, which already exists and does not mention KeeLoq. Nothing to author; publishing manufacturer codes is out of scope.

term512 is TERM512, a CardputerAdv expansion kit (3D-printed CapTFT enclosure + 2.8in ILI9341 display + AMS1117 module, no MCU) for the already-catalogued area512 firmware, not a board: https://github.com/Prokuon/term512

real board missing from the catalog, but no live primary source: docs.ai-thinker.com/en/esp32-cam serves only the site's JS shell (same bytes as a non-existent path) and ai-thinker.com does not answer, checked 2026-11-12

Not catalog content: 'tenstar' is TENSTAR ROBOT, an AliExpress store brand that resells many generic boards (ESP32-S3 SuperMini, ESP32-S3-Zero, ESP32-C3/H2 SuperMini; e.g. https://devices.esphome.io/devices/tenstar-robot-esp32-s3-supermini/), so 'esp32 tenstar' names no one specific board, and the brand has no manufacturer site (tenstar-robot.com, tenstarrobot.com, tenstar.com do not resolve, checked 2026-11-21)
